newsitem.title: USA: Paracelsian's Rhodes steps down as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Paracelsian's Rhodes steps down as CEO.

text.p: Paracelsian Inc said on Friday that as part of the company's planned managerial succession, Keith Rhodes, chairman of the board, president and chief executive officer, has stepped down as chief executive officer of the company.
Rhodes will continue to serve as chairman of the board and president of the company until the annual shareholders' meeting.
The board of directors has established a search committee to seek a replacement for Rhodes.

Pending the appointment of a new CEO, the company has established the office of the chief executive consisting of Keith Rhodes, Arthur Koch, chief financial officer and John Babbish, chief science officer.
